atomic_facts.fact: Bob Iger stepped down as Disney CEO effective March 18, 2026.
Upon stepping down, Iger transitioned into a Senior Advisor role at Disney.
As of October 1, 2026, Disney's official leadership page listed Robert A. Iger as Senior Advisor.
The leadership page states Iger also serves as a member of Disney's Board of Directors.
The leadership page identifies Iger as the former Chairman and CEO, not the current CEO.
Walt Disney Co filed a 10-Q exhibit (EX-31.A) on 2026-05-06 with a period of report of 2026-03-28.
Walt Disney Co filed a 10-Q exhibit (EX-31.A) on 2026-08-05 with a period of report of 2026-06-27.
The May and August 2026 filings listed Robert A. Iger as Chief Executive Officer at the time of filing.
The filings demonstrate a reporting lag after Iger's March 2026 departure as CEO.
